sources.title: Pieter Naaijkens, Quantum Spin Systems on Infinite Lattices, extended and corrected Summer 2016 lecture notes

contents.name: Finite local net, quasi-local completion, and induced translation action
contents.support: §§3.2.2–3.2.3, printed pp. 56–57 (actual PDF pp. 56–57), define the local net and norm-completed quasi-local algebra and state that the lattice translation group induces automorphisms. The local definition constructs the configuration relabelling unitaries, verifies their group law and proves the isometric extension directly; those exact details are not attributed to the source.

contents.support: The source supplies the lattice thermodynamic-limit convention. The item states the inner-boundary Følner condition explicitly and proves the pressure limit directly; it does not rely on an unstated equivalence between definitions.

sources.title: Oscar E. Lanford III and Derek W. Robinson, Statistical Mechanics of Quantum Spin Systems III, Communications in Mathematical Physics 9 (1968), 327–338
sources.locator: Complete 12-page PDF retrieved and read locally in full. The finite-spin algebra and translation setup is on printed pp. 331–333 (actual PDF pp. 5–7). Theorem 3.1 begins on printed p. 333 (actual PDF p. 7); its proof continues on printed p. 334 (actual PDF p. 8). The theorem states pressure existence and a variational supremum; its proof explicitly defers pressure existence and parts of the variational result to cited earlier papers, so those deferred proofs are not claimed as read or used.

contents.name: Translation automorphisms and invariant interactions
contents.support: Printed pp. 332–333 (actual PDF pp. 6–7): the translation group acts by automorphisms sending each local algebra to its translate, and interactions are invariant when the translated interaction equals the translated observable. The local definition gives the explicit configuration-basis unitary and norm-completion extension.
